prompt: A town that spirals up a hill to a temple at the top.

card.name: Spiral Hill Town

site.text: A town that spirals up a hill, its main road winding around the slope in a rising spiral to the summit

style.text: Warm, timeless hill-town look: stone and timber, pale plaster, terracotta-style roofs, with a grand temple crowning the top

purpose.text: A pilgrimage town whose life climbs toward the temple at the summit

card.interpretation: You asked for a town whose road spirals up a hill to a temple at the top. I read the site as a hilltop settlement using an existing hill, the style as a warm stone-and-timber hill town, and the purpose as a pilgrimage town where everything leads toward the temple. Medium size, with the temple as the one landmark.
assumptions: Style not given, so a warm stone-and-timber hill town look.
Purpose inferred as a pilgrimage town.
An existing hill will be found rather than sculpted.
Difficulty is patron, from the settings.

program.notes: Crowns the hill, visible from every turn of the spiral; broad steps and a terrace overlooking the town.
Marks the start of the spiral road at the foot of the hill.
Stepped along the spiral road, facing uphill toward the temple.
Small homes tucked between the turns of the road.
Rest stop at the lower third of the climb.
Along the road, selling offerings and goods.
Small shrine at the midpoint of the climb.
Just below the temple, overlooking the spiral.
